method: Exact Rodrigues quarter-turns: 32 hinge-sense assignments per net; all 24 determinant +1 signed-permutation rotations; exact corner/diagonal comparison on all six faces.
independence: No renderer or authoring code imported; no stored fold frames or expected answer used in calculation. The saved answer is compared only after enumerating all options.
public_information_scope: Visible three faces and explicitly stated blank other three faces. Printed outside fixes outward convex folds. No private hidden pattern is used.
